# monotaur_sensor (Data Source)

Reads a single Monotaur sensor by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "monotaur_sensor" "http_check" {
  id = "01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the sensor to look up.

### Read-Only

- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the sensor was created.
- `name` (String) The name of the sensor.
- `parameters` (String) JSON-encoded parameters for the sensor plugin.
- `plugin_name` (String) The name of the plugin that powers this sensor.
- `probe_id` (String) The ID of the probe this sensor belongs to.
- `type` (String) The type identifier of the sensor.
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the sensor was last updated.
